question: A alone can do (1/10) part of a work in 8 hours. B alone can do (1/5) part of same work in 4 hours. If they work together, then how many hours will they take to complete (9/16) part of the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A alone can do (1/10) part of a work in 8 hours.

B alone can do (1/5) part of same work in 4 hours.

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

A alone can do the total work = 8 × 10 = 80 hrs

B alone can do the total work = 4 × 5 = 20 hrs

Now,

Required work to be done by both person = (9/16) × 80 = 45 units

Required time = 45/5 = 9 hrs.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 hours.**
